text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo doesn't seem as upbeat as usual.

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You're looking under the weather, King…

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You've been working so hard lately. You must be tired.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohohoho! My silly darlings, you worry too much! There's nothing wrong whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Of course! A king never falters. Come on, let's do one more—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: M-my legs just got a bit tangled! Nothing to get yourselves worked up over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo may be acting strong, but it's obvious that she's tired. Maybe I should change her race schedule…
